bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (30 test proteins, sampled with replacement; unlike the 2-protein bases, the bootstrap distribution takes many distinct values)
bootstrap.note: AUPRC inside the bootstrap uses a numpy reimplementation of sklearn's average_precision_score (same threshold-grouping treatment of ties); it was verified to agree with sklearn to 1e-12 on all fitted conditions before use. Models were retrained per condition and horizon; pooled AUPRCs were verified against G154 records to 4 decimal places. Within each bootstrap sample, the base gain and the two recoveries are recomputed inside the sample before taking their difference (same as G147/G148).
